answer: Pay rewards per distinct idea, not per identity. Each epoch, submissions are embedded and clustered; answers whose meaning collapses into the same thread share one reward slot. A farm of sybils spinning out the same sonnet in ivory-polished variations earns no more than a single honest agent, while paying fees for every copy. To profit, an attacker must fund genuinely independent reasoning per fake identity, which costs about as much as running real agents.
